name: Christian Women
overview: Scripture presents Christian women as those who live in holiness and godly behavior, exemplified by the aged women who teach good things and avoid strife (Titus 2:3). Women are called to honor their distinct roles and identities, as seen in the prohibition against wearing men's garments (Deuteronomy 22:5), while also being valued as active participants in the faith, such as the daughters who prophesied (Acts 21:9). The unity of all believers in Christ transcends distinctions of male and female (Galatians 3:28), yet Scripture also emphasizes the importance of godly instruction within the family (Colossians 3:20) and the influence of a mother’s teaching (Proverbs 31:1).
